content.subject: Simulation terminal and manual checks
content.draft_text:
Hi Test,

I'm Zamp from Zamp Technologies. We help operations teams automate manual, reconciliation-heavy processes.

Saw that ShipBob’s Simulation Terminal now lets you simulate the full fulfillment lifecycle in sandbox without touching real inventory. I imagine keeping fulfillment test runs aligned across sandbox and production environments can become increasingly time-consuming.

We ingest sandbox simulation data and generate reconciled reports, reducing repetitive manual checks.

Curious if this is something you're thinking about right now? Happy to connect for a quick chat.

Best,
Zamp
